api.generate: evaluate(task_public,method,caller,run_dir) -> record. Methods A/B or Text2Cypher/Text2SQL. Does not execute DB queries.
api.sql_schema: relational/WG.manifest.json -> schema only; never feed whole manifest to model
api.file_identity: file_identity(SQL_DB) -> bytes/mtime_ns/device/inode; root pins after verifying full DB hash at WG batch start and verifies full hash again at batch end

generation_policy.format: exact JSON object with query:string and abstain:boolean

execution_policy.batch_fast_path: root verifies full graph/SQL source at batch start and end; Cypher each query owned container+unchanged import manifest+ordinary EXPLAIN+ordinary execution summary+rollback; SQL each query immutable read-only and pinned file identity

encoding_policy.native_projection: same shipped frozen-TTL parser/property/list/relationship codec as Neo4j restoration
encoding_policy.booleans: SQL INTEGER0/1 to bool only when predeclared field/schema is unambiguously boolean
encoding_policy.arrays_objects: canonical JSON SQL text decoded only for predeclared JSON field; recursively decode unambiguous boolean0/1 leaves
encoding_policy.multilabels: same node_id in each label table
encoding_policy.relationship_multiplicity: exact source/type/target triples are unique as in shipped RDF restoration; absent original multiplicity is not reconstructed
encoding_policy.auxiliary_loader_identity: node_identity(node_id,iri) encodes the exact shipped Neo4j loader-only /inst/_/{cls}/{nid} identity. Graph cards expose iri on each node label. This differs from original RDF sourceIRI and contributes no additional source-authored facts.

scientific_claim_limits: Synthetic tests use mocks; they are not model measurements.
Matching encoded source records does not establish causal fairness across representations.
No domain expert/human review is created.

synthetic_development_test.scope: Mock calls, synthetic two-node SQL data and mock graph transactions. Not benchmark/model measurements.
